variable: Sea level next to the city (ECCO dynamic sea surface height)
method: Nearest ocean cells (up to 4, within 120 km), cos(latitude) mean. Monthly series deseasonalised; OLS trend with autocorrelation-adjusted 95% CI; Mann-Kendall with Sen's slope; Benjamini-Hochberg across all coastal cities.
caveat: Ocean-model sea level next to the coast. It does not include land sinking, which is a large part of flooding in Jakarta and Semarang.
